requiredBehavior: Expose a fail-closed generic invocation surface accepting an authoritative exported callable identity, interface/signature identity, typed argument material, and applicable generic arguments while preserving capability admission and returning a bounded typed result.
summary: Profile 0.18 supports host invocation by module/function name and explicit generic type arguments, but it does not expose a bounded identity-bound invocation membrane that validates a compiler callable identity and heterogeneous typed argument material without consumer-specific dispatch generation.
title: No identity-bound reflective invocation for heterogeneous typed callables
